title: RH MTC Commitment v0.0.1 Schema
description: Schema for the client-verifiable commitment entry. Its leaf hash can be independently computed from {logId, monitoringLogId, monitoringLogIndex, subtreeSignatures} without any additional data. Certificate holders reconstruct this JSON, compute SHA-256(0x00 || canonicalized), and verify against the inclusion proof.

logId.description: Identifier of the commitment log (32 bytes, base64-encoded).

monitoringLogId.description: Identifier of the monitoring log (32 bytes, base64-encoded).

monitoringLogIndex.description: The log index of the corresponding rhmtcmonitoring entry in the monitoring log.

subtreeSignatures.description: One or more signatures over the Merkle subtree root, one per configured signing key.

algorithm.description: The signature algorithm used (e.g. ECDSA_P256_SHA_256, ML_DSA_65).

subtreeRoot.description: The Merkle subtree root hash that was signed (32 bytes, base64-encoded).

treeSize.description: The size of the Merkle tree (number of leaf nodes).

keyHint.description: Hint to identify the signing public key (first 8 hex chars of key hash).

start.description: Start index (inclusive) of the subtree range.

end.description: End index (exclusive) of the subtree range.
